title: Sealed: Old Faithful's next 300

claim_kind: prediction (sealed before the event; not yet scored)
prediction: Each of the next 300 intervals between Old Faithful eruptions is forecast as the seed of all the intervals before it (q = 0.95; the first forecast is 92.39 minutes). The claim that could fail: the seed misses by at least 2 per cent less, on average, than every rival.
baseline: Rules fixed the same night: persistence, the mean of the last 50, the field's rule (next interval = 147.4916 + -0.5768 x last interval (fitted on the stored table, then fixed)) and a decoy. On the second half of the stored table their mean misses were crr 15.634, field 11.956, running mean 15.461, persistence 26.87, decoy 16.341.
opens_words: on or after 20 December 2026, once GeyserTimes holds 300 intervals that start at or after 20 November 2026 00:00 UTC
status_line: A sealed envelope. Opens on or after 20 December 2026, once GeyserTimes holds 300 intervals that start at or after 20 November 2026 00:00 UTC.
why: The event has not happened, so nothing could be scored tonight. The envelope is sealed (seal 829efbdd3af0...) and will be scored by its own frozen rule when it opens.
